jobs_results.title: Commercial Project Manager
jobs_results.company_name: Siemens Gas and Power GmbH & Co. KG
jobs_results.description:
As Commercial Project Manager, you will play a key role in providing finance support and co-ordination to Grid Technologies Sales organization. This role covers commercial activities as, c reation and manage sales orders / Invoicing, cost control and business analysis.

You will have a strong interaction with others commercial project managers, technical project managers and overall business support functions, being responsible for commercial and contractual requirements of the Sales Orders / Projects are met, accounting rules, payment plans, taxation, collections are followed, financial forecasting, and risk management is enabled.

How You’ll Make an Impact

· Ensures all related Project Reporting and Controlling activities.

· Supports the Commercial Project Manager Head and Project Manager in identifying, evaluating and assessing risk and opportunities, strategies and response activities – taking over the full responsibility in this regard with respect to all commercial risks and... opportunities.

· Project Cost and Free Cash Flow Forecasting. Maintain good quality of forecasting accuracy.

· Ensure accurate balance Sheet Accounting.

· Facilitate prompt invoicing to the customer.

· Actively manages accounts receivables and collections arrive on time.

· Actively supervises guarantees and makes sure the guarantees are collected upon expiry for credit limit management.

· Reporting and presentation of various business KPI as and when required.

· Ensures the accuracy of project books and records, including recording of such in the appropriate systems, e.g. SAP - ensures compliance with Siemens-FRG plus the local Gaap requirements.

· Drive digitalization.

· Handle other Business Unit specific requests.

What You Bring
• Good knowledge about SAP & MS Office

· Knowledge in IFRS accounting standards.

Our team is a vibrant mix of dedicated professionals, each bringing a unique set of skills and experiences to the table. We are also a team that values the spirit of camaraderie, fun and trust.

We are a team that learns together, grows to our professional backgrounds, but also to our personal ones, as we represent a multitude of cultures and languages.

The multicultural and multilingual nature of together, and most importantly, enjoys working together. Our diversity doesn't divide us; it unites us.

A group that is committed to achieving its goals while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and enjoyable work environment for all its members.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With 96,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences

· Work-life balance: Flexible working time,

· Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

· Local benefits such as meal allowance, flexible plan and much more

· Self-driven development frameworkwith insights and resources to develop and grow on technical and soft skills. Continuous learning
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Customer Project Manager - EMEA*
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA

Company Description

Why TOMRA?

TOMRA is a world leader in optical and electronic sorting equipment. TOMRA Sorting Solutions is a dynamic company with an outstanding product line and an excellent level of customer satisfaction.

Why is it worthwhile to start and stay at TOMRA? Quite simply, we are a steadily growing international company that has retained its family atmosphere. Our corporate culture is Norwegian, which means there is no hierarchical thinking. If you are interested in titles and hierarchy you are at the wrong place here. We see a bright future in economic terms. Aside from that, it´s nice to know that our recycling machines are helping to make the world cleaner.

At TOMRA, we place significant emphasis on maximizing resource value and utilization, which contributes to the concept of the circular economy: an economic system designed to keep products, components and materials at their highest value throughout... their life cycles within a closed loop.

Technology plays a crucial role in achieving this, with advances in certain fields helping to bring about new approaches that can help maximize the value of resources and – crucially – reduce waste.

OUR ROLE

TOMRA’s sensor-based solutions play a key role in optimizing resource productivity, particularly in the fields of waste management and recycling, where sensor-based technology can be used to increase precision and streamline processes.

To achieve the ambitious aim of a circular economy, it is necessary to employ state-of-the-art approaches that push boundaries, and TOMRA’s reverse vending and waste sorting solutions help to achieve this by recovering materials and providing valuable insight into the composition of these materials.

The result is a greater understanding of where efficiencies can be made to minimize costs and waste, and better utilize resources within a closed loop – further mitigating the impact of CO2 and other emissions and inefficiencies.

Job Description

Your responsibilities will include:
• Managing of Projects in Metal and Waste Recycling according to applicable procedures.
• Reviewing sales inputs and contract details
• Internal project coordination (PSR) by using relevant software (ERP-System, etc.)
• Interface clearance with internal and external customers
• Achievement of customer acceptance
• Monitor including payments
• Distribute project closure reports and post-calculation of costs.
• Establishing and maintaining reliable relationships with our customers to solve problems.
• Providing technical consultancy for customers and sales on complex plant designs.
• Supporting the sales team.
• Ensuring successful project execution including project costs and timing to the satisfaction of our customers.
• Driving continuous process improvements within the area of responsibility.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with the following profile:
• Technical education and knowledge are essential.
• Fluent proficiency in French and English is essential.
• Residing in France close to an airport or in Germany close to Koblenz.
• Willingness to travel approximately 60%, sometimes abroad.
• Self-motivation and proven capacity to fully complete tasks.
• Excellent level of coordination and organization skills.
• Strong IT and network skills.
• Business experience in a support function.
• Ability to read drawings.
• Good communication skills both verbally and in writing.
• Very good problem-solving skills.
• Ability to relate to local customers, their views, and issues (preferably experience in the local culture).

Additional Information

Interested?

Please send your CV in English.

(!) We value your time, instead of lengthy motivation letter, simply answer following questions in the "Message to Hiring Manager" section when submitting your resume:
• What is the name of the main sorting machine at TOMRA Recycling?
• Do you have a technical education?
• Do you speak French?
• Tomra does not discriminate based on gender, race or ethnicity, religion, skin color, sexual orientation or identity, disability, age, and other protected status characteristics according to applicable law. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive environment and take pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

Most importantly, it fits!

#LI-MH1

jobs_results.title: PROJECT MANAGER-VILADECAVALLS
jobs_results.description:
MISSION

Ensure, through continuous support, training and supervision, targets are reached for profit, cost, investment, quality and timing for the projects lead by the Project Managers overseen.

Support and coach activity of team of Project Managers ensuring they comply with and improve on the Ficosa Development System and related tools and procedures.

GENERAL FUNCTIONS
• Monitor project KPI’s for projects of country or region for EBIT, quality and timing and report results monthly to the Regional Projects Director or Regional CEO / COO and Corporate Projects Director.
• Assure that technical and functional requirements, including costumer specific requirements (CSR) are satisfied along the project life.
• Obtain the access to the customer b2b portal and grant access to the rest of the project team as required.
• Among other tasks and responsibilities, it has to fulfill all the tasks and responsibilities defined in the RACI matrix of FDS (P-ID-XX / XX-01)
• Support and coach... activity of assigned team of Projects Managers, ensuring that they comply with internal development methodology (FDS), use tools laid out by Ficosa (TC / TP, CMS, etc.

and procedures required by customer at all times.
• Reach profitability target during the FDS project life-cycle (Phase 1-7).
• Support the Sales Area in improving relationship with clients through visits, presentations, etc.
• Prevent projects from deviating in development / quality / timing and establish action plans when needed.
• Determine priorities for critical projects with project teams.
• Ensure ongoing improvement of Ficosa Development System (FDS), TCTP and CMS.
• Ensure proper communication / benchmarking and knowledge sharing between project teams.
• Observe Ficosa’s Code of Ethics to avoid fraudulent practices. Comply with Information Security Management System (ISMS) applicable to the job, along with the training related thereto.
• Lead the team, guaranteeing its effectiveness, development and motivation, fostering Ficosa's values.
• Provide the team with the necessary means to comply with OHSE rules, ensuring they are properly used.
• Actively cooperate in maintaining, promoting and improving the OHSE and Quality department.

The described functions are the most representative for this position and are in no way a comprehensive list.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Academic background :

Bachelor’s degree

Languages :

Fluent local language & Fluent English (spoken and written)

Experience :

Minimum of 2 years in a similar position

Travel : Willing to travel

Willing to travel

OTHER SPECIFICATIONS

Additional training :

Knowledge of project management or finance would be of additional value

jobs_results.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - 4700
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager (4699) with a strong technical background in the telecommunications industry to lead our projects in the European market.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager , you will be responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of complex technical projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This role requires excellent leadership skills, deep technical expertise, and a thorough understanding of the telecommunications landscape in the EU.

Job Responsibilities
• Lead the end-to-end management of complex technical projects in the telecommunications sector, from initiation to closure.
• Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer requirements.
• Coordinate resources, including internal teams, external vendors, and subcontractors, to ensure project deliverables are... met on time and within budget.
• Manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies to minimize impact and ensure project success.
• Monitor project progress and performance, tracking key metrics and milestones to identify deviations and take corrective actions as needed.
• Communicate project status, updates, and risks to stakeholders, including executive management, customers, and project teams.
• Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards relevant to telecommunications projects in the EU.
• Provide leadership and mentorship to project team members, supporting their professional growth and development.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, sales, and operations, to drive project success and customer satisfaction

Job Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. Master’s degree or PMP certification is a plus.
• Proven experience in project management roles within the telecommunications industry, with a focus on technical projects.
• Deep understanding of telecommunications technologies, including mobile networks, fixed-line networks, and emerging technologies such as 5G and IoT.
• Experience with project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall, with the ability to adapt approaches based on project needs.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks and resources effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and propose effective solutions.
• Experience working in a multicultural and multilingual environment, with proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Willingness to travel within the EU region as needed for project meetings, workshops, and customer engagements.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Compliance Project Manager - Eastern Europe
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Binance is the leading global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider whose suite of financial products includes the world’s largest digital-asset exchange.
Our mission is to accelerate cryptocurrency adoption and increase the freedom of money.

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, mission-driven organization where opportunities to learn and excel are endless, then Binance is the place for you.

Responsibilities
• Prepare and maintain project documents (e.g. kick-off, road map, status updates, RAID log, steering committees, gap analysis etc.) to ensure proper control framework
• Oversee engagement and deployment of vendor solutions globally and work with global compliance managers to set up new processes
• Coordinate with global and regional team to lead change and best-practices, as well as perform read-across to identify gaps and driving projects to close the gaps
• Ensure proper coordination and... engagement with compliance and other cross functional stakeholders to work and drive towards project outcome
• Participate in requirements gathering and drafting of BRD where required, and design efficient tool workflows
• Perform business analysis, process mapping, and providing solutions and recommendations for respective projects
• Support in preparing project update slides for senior management reporting ensuring all artifacts such as minutes and action are detailed and circulated in a timely manner
• Participate in internal and external programs related to AML/CFT and other subjects that may form part of the day to day work requirements
• Any general administration and ancillary activities as may be required and related to the above functions in accordance with the business requirements of the Company

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a Business, Finance, Legal, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 3-5 years of experience in project management at a financial institution or fintech company
• Knowledgeable of compliance area and vendor solutions
• PMP certification required, PRINCE2 or other certifications will be an advantage
• Experience working with directly with an independent compliance monitor or financial regulators preferred
• Ability to proactively and assertively communicate to project stakeholders where required
• Ability to navigate through ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to be action-oriented and seek to meet high standards
• Excellent written and verbal communication, time management, analytical, and investigative skills

Working at Binance
• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Balance life and work with flexible working hours and casual work attire

Learn more about how Binancians embody the organization’s core values, creating a unified culture that enables collaboration, excellence, and growth.

Apply today to be a part of the Web3 revolution!

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager / Account Manager
jobs_results.description:
Talented and enthusiastic professionals always have a place in Studio Banana.

– Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.
– Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
– Assist in the definition of project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
– Ensure resource availability and allocation.
– Develop a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress.
– Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule, and project costs using appropriate verification techniques.
– Identify, track, escalate and help solve project issues, conflicts and problems.
– Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques.
– Successfully manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders.
– Perform risk management to minimize project risks.
– Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors.
– Create and maintain... comprehensive project documentation.
– Oversee the accounting, costing and billing.

MUST HAVE:

– 5+ years of proven working experience in Graphic & Editorial project management, preferably in the creative/cultural/communications sectors; experience in Digital Projects is highly valuable.
– Experience in Events Organization and Photo Shooting Sessions coordination is also desirable.
– Results-oriented, patient and ability to work under stress.

🚚 Founded in 2014, Shippeo is a French based SaaS company providing supply chain visibility. Shippeo has grown from 70 to 220 employees during the last two years and is continuing to rapidly scale after an additional $40M fundraising round in October 2022.

Shippeo is an exceptionally diverse company with colleagues from 27 different nationalities and speaking 29 languages. With offices throughout Europe, North America and recently Asia, Shippeo provides global coverage to all of our clients.

Job Description

👩‍💻 As a Project Manager, you will join a team of 20 members with diverse international backgrounds who are... responsible for the implementation of the Shippeo solution across multiple customer organizations and a wide range of different industries.

You will lead the implementation process for multiple clients simultaneously, being fully responsible for the success of the roll-out. Your role will be central to the organization and you will have the chance to work closely with various internal and external teams.

Reporting to the Project Director, as a Project Manager your responsibilities will include:
• Guide the customer through the whole implementation process – collect client requirements, build the project plan, support the technical setup, train the key users, handle regular reporting, lead change management.
• Organize and lead weekly customer project meetings to follow-up on current and next actions ensuring a smooth roll-out as well as steering committees to review goals, progress, risks, and opportunities with all stakeholders.
• Travel occasionally, if necessary for client projects or internal workshops.
• Work closely with our Customer Success team to ensure project management delivery is aligned with clients required business outcomes.
• Coordinate and lead the internal teams involved on the implementation (Product, Support, Carriers onboarding).
• Work on internal cross-team projects and initiatives to further strengthen our product and organization
• Identify risks and issues to effectively delivering the implementation as planned and build a risk mitigation plan
• Collaborate with interns on your projects and help them grow within their position

Qualifications

🎊 We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to join our team as a project manager, who can demonstrate the following skills and qualifications:
• ​Fluency in English and Dutch/French/German/Italian (knowledge of a third European language is a plus)
• 1 to 2 years of experience working in an Analyst or Project Management role, preferably at a consulting firm or comparable background
• Autonomy and willingness to take on challenging responsibilities in a fast-growing company that aims to revolutionize an entire industry
• Strong organizational skills as well as the ability to multitask and prioritize workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent analytical skills to quickly identify problems and propose effective solutions
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal in order to efficiently handle daily client and internal requests.
• Proficient interpersonal skills, demonstrated by the ability to build authentic business relationships and effectively manage relational challenges

Additional Information

Hiring process
• A 30-minute interview with our talent acquisition manager
• Discovery call with our Project Manager Director (1h )
• Business case and presentation (1h)

We are looking for talents who share our values:
• 🚀 Ambition
• 💙 Care
• 🎯 Deliver
• 🤝 Collaboration

Find out more about our values in Our Culture Book

If you identify with our values and enjoy working in a fast-paced and international environment, Shippeo is just the place for you!

We are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion within our workplace as we value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring to our team. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all candidates, regardless of their background or abilities, and our commitment to inclusion is reflected in our policies, practices, and workplace culture.

We understand that candidates may have unique needs or questions related to disability inclusion. To facilitate this, you can reach our dedicated Disability Advisor at [email protected] with any inquiries or requests for accommodations during the application process.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Do you get a kick out of projects that run smoothly from start to finish with a stunning end result? Are you ready to be given a lot of responsibility within the projects you run and do you feel like working for fat hospitality companies? Then be sure to read on!

Hi, we are The Fully Bookers
We are the online marketing agency dedicated to the hospitality industry. Every day, we help (inter)national hotels and restaurants such as Anne & Max, Proeflokaal Bregje, Pizza Beppe, Carlton and Parco Ibiza in making their dreams come true in terms of visibility, reach and profit.

With our years of experience for this sector, we have interesting data and the right experience to help these entrepreneurs maximise their occupancy rates.

We are a fast-growing organisation where the Project Management team is responsible for running all the projects we run with our clients.

Project Manager
As Project Manager at The Fully Bookers, you help our clients achieve maximum results by organising project... activities properly. After team Account has coordinated the strategy, you make sure it is implemented: you plan, execute, monitor and adjust where necessary. For this, you work closely with the client and our internal experts.

You will have a lot of freedom to shape your work, but we expect you to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget and of excellent quality. You have perseverance and know what Agile working entails. In addition, you make the project progress and results transparent to our customers.

Our new Project Manager has project management skills, is incisive and knows how to get things done. You are innovative and come up with creative solutions when needed. You have in-depth knowledge of the world of online marketing, closely follow the latest developments and have a demonstrable affinity with the hospitality industry.

You have at least three years' experience within project management on an agency side. You are fluent in Dutch, have strong communication skills and are proficient in English. Your enthusiastic energy gets people involved in your projects to achieve the best possible results. We are looking for someone who can work full-time.

What do we have to offer you?
In everything we do within The Fully Bookers, we keep our core values in mind:

BETTER is what we do best

BOLD is our middle name

With us, you get the chance to work with the top 10 per cent within the hospitality industry. We provide the necessary equipment and a nice workplace at our office in The Hague. It is also possible to regularly work from home.

Because we believe in mutual trust, you will receive a permanent contract immediately, with pension accrual. The salary indication for this position is between €3,000 and €4,000 per month, depending on your experience.

We also believe that you need to develop to on top of your game remain, hence we provide annual training funds. To relax, you have the opportunity to participate in company fitness, chair massage, monthly drinks and a biannual company outing. To explore the world or remodel your home, you have 24 fixed, four optional holidays available. Should you have the dream of working from abroad, this is possible for five weeks a year.

Do our core values appeal to you? And do you recognise yourself in the description above? Top! Then apply immediately via the following link and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Acquisition on the basis of this vacancy is not appreciated: we like to use our own network to find the right person.
Want to come and bolster our team?

We're the number 1 in online marketing for restaurants and hotels. With offices in The Hague and Amsterdam, although working from home is an option, too.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Maintenance and Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Job family : Operations | Position : Maintenance | Area : Spain | Region : Huesca | Contract : Permanent position |
Key responsabilities

Welcome diversity and apply as you are!

At Adisseo, we cherish value of diversity whatever it may be.

Feeding more than 9 billion people by 2050 in a high-quality, affordable, safe and sustainable way is one of the major challenges facing humanity and it is the “raison d’être” of ADISSEO.

By joining Adisseo , you will join committed women and men who make the difference every day to contribute to this challenge.

By joining Adisseo , you will integrate a dynamic international environment

By joining Adisseo , you will discover a world of opportunities for every stage of your career by being actor to your professional journey.

Don’t hesitate any longer and apply now!

Missions of the job

The maintenance and project manager ensures that all industrial tools (installations, equipment) are kept in good working condition and anticipates the risks of... malfunctioning. You will implement a maintenance plan that ensures the availability and safety of equipment in accordance with a defined budget and compliant with all QHSE regulations related to its activities.

Your range of responsibilities is fourfold:
• You will ensure the maintenance of operational units by implementing the department’s preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance policy
• You will improve the reliability of installations and optimize maintenance costs
• You will participate in the implementation of new works and/or development studies
• You will lead a team of technicians and project engineers in the SBU Specialties

Tasks and responsibilities
• Propose detailed provisional budgets, analyze expenditures and proceed with the necessary arbitrations
• Identify and apply the means to assess the condition of the installation and equipment
• Develop and propose preventive maintenance plans for production and service control and in close collaboration with the manufacturing and maintenance department
• Planning, coordination and monitoring of work during production stoppages with the aim of minimizing machine downtime and installations downtime caused by maintenance
• Set up plans for interventions by external providers and supervision of their work
• Follow-up of external repairs and standard changes
• Ensure the decommissioning of equipment by carrying out control checks with the licensed authorities and the maintenance department
• You are responsible for certification of repairs and pre-inspection before restarting activity
• Participate in the establishment of a monitoring system to identify, analyze and address major trends in the causes of failures and/or breakdowns and/or unscheduled operations
• Research and propose technical solutions
• Participate in the implementation of indicators on its activity, expenses and costs, the implementation of changes and the monitoring of results, as well as the transmission to its superior management
• Coordinate and monitor requests for studies and modifications in accordance with the budget
• Coordination and follow-up with the site maintenance department on the completion of work, new buildings and investments
• Ensuring compliance with QHSEI standards, company safety instructions
• Participate in the necessary evaluation studies of all new projects
• Applying MOC
• Manage the organization of your team
Main Skills

TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and standards in relation to the site activity
• Solid technical knowledge of maintenance
• Knowledge of mechanics, electricity, instrumentation, process safety…
• Knowledge of the different buildings, facilities and working procedures of the site
• Knowledge of the SEVESO standard (on the control of major-accident hazards involving dangerous substances)
• FAMI-QS and HACCP knowledge
• Knowledge of Quality, Safety, Environmental and Food Hygiene regulations
• Knowledge of Operational Excellence Tools
• Knowledge of ISO standards

SOFT SKILLS
• Ability to work autonomous and take initiative
• Strong organizational skills: to organize your work related to priority management and responsiveness
• Possess good analytical and synthesis skills
• You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• You are courageous to make proposals and decisions
• You have experience in Leadership and Team Management
• You have a dynamic personality
• Work experience in a matrix organization and network is a plus

HARD SKILLS
• Good knowledge of MS Office programs
• Knowledge of SAP
• Knowledge of languages: English is mandatory, in speaking and writing, knowledge of French is considered a plus
• Basic knowledge of accounting (budgeting)

EDUCATION
• Minimum 5 years of experience in an Engineering or Maintenance Department in an industrial company

What we offer
• A full-time job, based in Alcalá de Gurrea, with the possibility to work hybrid for one day per week after one year in the position
• A great opportunity to learn new things and to gain more experience in project management
• A challenging position, in a fun and dynamic team
• An attractive salary package with fringe benefits
• Relevant on-the-job training with an extensive onboarding program
• A great environment to work in
• Part of a worldwide leader company in animal nutrition with a great focus in sustainability

If your application is considered favorably, 3 to 4 interviews will be scheduled with our teams (direct manager, Human ressources manager, department director). ADISSEO is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Consultant Clinical Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Join our global team dedicated to innovation and initiative, where physical walls and different time zones don’t limit, but encourage, collaboration. Where all contributions and new ideas are explored with an open mind and work is driven by our shared values: be courageous, be accountable, be honest, be inclusive and elevate others.

Job Description Summary
The Clinical Project Manager is responsible for coordinating all efforts for the study within the Organization and through the oversight of a wide variety of vendors. The candidate will coordinate different functional groups within the clinical research department (clinical science, biostatistics, data management, medical writing, medical and safety) as well as vendors responsible for the execution of the studies, ensuring proper conduct and timely completion of all projects.

Job Description

Main responsibilities
• Manages clinical research project teams and vendors to... deliver a high-quality clinical study
• Drives and manages proactively all aspects of the project management process from initiation, planning, execution, control and closure
• May assist in developing protocol concept sheet (study design, entry criteria and schedule of activities table). Reviews protocol and CRFs.
• Oversees project budgets and manages cost to budgets. In collaboration with identified vendors, develops enrollment projections and (if necessary) product supply needs as part of the budget.
• In collaboration with the identified vendors is responsible for creating and maintaining MS Project timelines for each project and uses these timelines to track and manage a project’s progress.
• In collaboration with the identified vendors is responsible for creating Project Plans (e.g. Responsibility Table, Communication Plans, Study Oversight Plan).
• Reviews study-related support materials created by the identified vendors or clinical research teams (e.g. study manual, monitoring plan, edit check manual, Listing Review process).
• Oversees actual study conduct and quality at all levels.
• Ensures all vendors and clinical research groups provide timely and quality deliverables. Informs all groups of deliverables and timeline, project developments and ensures completion according to timelines.
• Manages and coordinates all vendors involved in the clinical study (central lab, CROs, etc.) including managing the Request for Proposal processes and overall budget for each.
• Collaborates with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.
• Monitors progress against contract and prepares/presents project and/or sub-team information proactively to stakeholders internally and externally.
• Manages risk (positive and negative) and contingencies proactively and leads problem solving and resolution efforts.
• Achieves project quality by identifying quality risks and issues, responding to issues raised by vendors, project team and/or sub-team members and planning/implementing appropriate corrective and preventative action plans.

Background
• BA/BS or equivalent with at least 3 years of clinical project management experience in the CRO or bio-/pharmaceutical industry
• Previous experience in real-world and late phase studies
• Experience in decentralized clinical trials will be a plus
• Expertise with MS Project and Excel
• Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate senior level scientific management personnel and to resolve project issues across organizations
• Excellent English
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Willing to work part time (0.4-0.6 FTE)

Languages

Education

Contract Type
Contingency Workforce
